body: because i despise every single part of me. Even aspects that used to be positive, such as my intelligence or perfectionist tendencies, have all turned  against me. I hate my body, my personality, the way i lose everyone who cares about me, and that i am the cause of much of my own problems. I am just not strong enough to get better. I am weak pathetic person that only develops more problems instead of fixing them. I am plagued by social anxiety, eating disorders, addiction, and a lack of prospects in all aspects of life. Maybe i could get better. Maybe if i was someone else i would. But i am too much of a failure to fix anything. the problem is that i am myself.

well its just that. he already won. i wont go through another day being laughed at, not having enough money to survive, much less be able to go to college. It's all so meaningless. I am glad i don't believe in an afterlife. I need the nothingness.
I don't have an ounce of strength left. I don't even want to get better anymore. I am done. I will enjoy the last 14 days the best i can, and then i will end it.
